invariant_text: Every distribution extracts to an independent repository with preserved canonical source and package digests.
method: Copied src/python/nrrd/ verbatim (48 files, excluding build/dist/__pycache__/.egg-info/etc.) into a fresh OS-temp directory with no ancestor relationship to this repository, confirmed byte-identical against the original, built a wheel+sdist from that isolated copy with its own cwd (never this repository root), built a second wheel+sdist from the in-place source at the same pinned SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, and compared artifact digests.
note: This is one of product-goal.yaml's own completion invariants, separate from the 10-item gate list (installed-wheel, independent-oracle, corpus, security, resource, typing, documentation, compatibility, performance, reproducible-build). Not a certification claim -- the other outstanding program-wide invariant (all-six-co-install) and this format's own remaining evidence are tracked independently.
